name: general-ontology
description: Build a topic ontology on any subject, one discovery at a time: a deterministic, standard-library Python kit with the onto CLI and a stdio MCP server (onto_* tools: one-call briefs and task context in a token budget, cards, search, gaps, interview questions, reviewed proposals, imports of other released topics), a session-start hook that starts the interview in a new topic, and six skills: onto (the router), onto-interview, onto-ingest, onto-review, onto-compose and onto-deliver.
